svg.title: A key for carbon-based readers
svg.desc: Sign key for the alien script. Letters A to Z sit in a grid: the row is the sign's shape (stem, twin, vee, bowl, fork, slant) and the column its ending (none, ring, dot, hook, strike). Numbers 0 to 9 are beads counted on two cords. Worked example: a bowl ending in a ring is Q.
